authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: Don't add generic cEDH win packages or Painter + Grindstone combos (source decision).
Don't drop the connect/protection count for more discard.

blueprint_failure_modes.description: No {2}{B} on resolution: the trigger does nothing.
Opponents stuck on empty hands but the deck lacks a fast kill.

value.interaction: Counters (Force of Will, Mana Drain, Swan Song) plus Toxic Deluge/Damnation for blockers.
value.mana: Fast mana (Mana Vault, Chrome Mox, Mox Diamond, Dark Ritual) to land a six-drop early.
value.protection: Two haste/protection equipment, Plaza, Regalia ward, free protection.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Crosis's combat trigger is the deck's largest discard event; equipment, Painter and haste pieces exist to make it land.
accepted_role.honest_note: Six mana, needs combat damage and another {2}{B}; the deck has no compact kill. It wins by attrition, discard punishment and combat, so the B4 rating comes more from the card pool (fast mana, Force of Will, Mind Twist) than from a fast win.
